Capra is an upcoming Voat client for iOS, written by me, /u/exidy.

Who are you? Just some guy. I have some experience writing iOS applications. Sometimes I even get paid for it.

How did Capra come about? I came across Voat a while ago, but noticed it didn't have any mobile clients. I had a look at the API and discovered it was inadequate for the purpose of writing a client. So I contacted /u/Atko and offered my assistance. I made some suggestions for a new API, which /u/Puttitout has been kind enough to implement.

What's your plan for Capra? I intend to get an MVP out as soon as I can. The MVP will be a read-only client to get some feedback on the UI and UX. Commenting and submitting will follow after that.

What's your design philosophy? I want Capra to be simple, clean and elegant. Gestures over buttons, and not exposing a million options.

Will it be open-source? Not initially.

Objective-C or Swift? Undecided on this one. I like Swift, but feeling a bit burned after updating even a small project to Swift 1.2. Maybe both. :)

What can I do to help? Post your feature ideas and suggestion to this subverse, and let people up, down and comment!
